title: EKS Setup Schema - Declarations
description: Global property declarations. v1.2.1: discipline_registry changed to $ref-only. v1.2.2: project_rules_registry changed to $ref-only (inline values moved to eks_project_rules_config.json) per audit — SSOT enforced. v1.3.0: added project_setup property (T1.67). v1.4.0: reshaped project_setup to DCC-aligned object model (folders/root_files/schema_files/environment/dependencies/discovery_rules/validation_rules/project_metadata) per T1.85. v1.5.0: flattened project_setup — setup values (folders/root_files/schema_files/environment/dependencies/project_metadata) are now TOP-LEVEL properties (no project_setup wrapper), aligning EKS eks_config.json with DCC project_config.json (T1.90). v1.6.0: added system_parameters property for T1.97/I088. v1.7.0: added workflow_files and tool_files top-level properties for T1.98.6/I090 (DCC project_config parity). v1.8.0: added project_definition property for I265 T1.190 — per-project definition registry superseding project_rules_registry. v1.9.0: removed project_rules_registry property + required entry for I265 T1.196 — eks_project_rules_config.json retired. v1.10.0 (I281 T1.223): added processing_profiles property — object keyed {type}_profiles (extraction/chunking/embedding/asset/ontology/retrieval/prompt/validation/indexing/ai_reasoning/graph_mapping), each a name→per-type-def map; validates eks_processing_config.json (SSOT §9 — values live there, never in base/setup). v1.11.0 (I287 T1.239): processing_profiles gains filename_profiles + file_property_profiles + os_properties sections — the Phase-1 file-processing chain consolidated from doc config (T1.238). v1.12.0 (I307 T1.276): added db_tables + export_views properties — schema-driven DB-layer tables (53 table specs in eks_db_config.json) and default export views (eks_export_view_config.json). Both are optional (not in required — they validate dedicated config files, not the core config). v1.13.0 (I312 T1.301): added db_manifest_keys property — declared key taxonomy for the db_manifest provenance table (SSOT, manifest.py is a generic writer over it).

project_definition.description: Per-project definitions (I265 T1.190). Keys are project codes. Profile references resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver at runtime. Replaces project_rules_registry as the project-specific SSOT.

processing_profiles.description: Reusable processing profile registries (I281 T1.223). Object keyed by profile-type section — each {type}_profiles key maps profile names to their per-type def. Actual VALUES live in eks_processing_config.json (SSOT §9/§16); base/setup hold shape only. v1.11.0 (I287 T1.239): added filename_profiles (name→filename_profile_def), file_property_profiles (name→file_property_profile_def, bound_extraction_profile inherits extraction_method per I277 gate), and os_properties (TOP-LEVEL shared key, Q1) — the Phase-1 file-processing chain sections.

filename_profiles.description: Reusable filename parsing profiles keyed by profile name (I287 T1.238 — consolidated from doc config filename_profiles). Profile names referenced by Project Definition document_profile.filename_pattern.

file_property_profiles.description: Per-file-type property extraction profiles keyed by profile name (I287 T1.238 — consolidated from doc config file_property_patterns.by_file_type). Each binds supported_extensions to an extraction profile via bound_extraction_profile (I277 gate). Naming convention {extraction_profile}_props cross-checked by SchemaLoader.

os_properties.description: OS-level property collection (I287 T1.238 Q1 — TOP-LEVEL shared key, NOT nested per profile).

extraction_profiles.description: Extraction (parsing) profiles keyed by profile name.

discipline_registry.description: Reference to discipline fragment schema (SSOT — must update eks_discipline_schema.json for new disciplines)

project_registry.description: Reference to project code fragment schema

folders.description: Required and optional project folders (top-level — DCC project_config pattern, T1.90)

root_files.description: Files required at project root level (top-level, T1.90)

schema_files.description: Required JSON schema definition files (top-level, T1.90)

workflow_files.description: Pipeline/workflow files required by the project (top-level, DCC project_config pattern, T1.98.6/I090)

tool_files.description: Tool/utility files required by the project (top-level, DCC project_config pattern, T1.98.6/I090)

discovery_rules.description: Pattern-based rules for auto-discovering files (top-level, T1.90)

environment.description: Environment specifications for the project (top-level, T1.90)

validation_rules.description: Validation rules for project setup (top-level, T1.90)

db_tables.description: I307 (T1.276): Schema-driven DB-layer table specifications — actual values live in eks_db_config.json (SSOT §9/§16). Each item $refs table_spec_def, which composes columns (array of column_spec_def, min 1, required name+column_type), foreign_keys (array of fk_spec_def), id_strategy (id_strategy_def, required), and optional transform (transform_def). additionalProperties:false is enforced inside table_spec_def.

export_views.description: I307 (T1.276): Default export view specifications — actual values live in eks_export_view_config.json (SSOT §9/§16). Each item $refs export_view_def with required view_id/source_table/columns/file_base_name/sheet_name/formats. Replaces the hardcoded export file/sheet names at eks_engine_pipeline.py:270-287.

db_manifest_keys.description: I312 (T1.301): declared key taxonomy for the db_manifest provenance table. manifest.py is a generic writer over this spec (no code-literal key lists, AGENTS.md §15/§16).

config_sources.description: Map of manifest config-version key suffix to source config filename (SSOT for which config versions are recorded).
